Extends intellectual-property protection for the U.S. opportunity, but does not establish FDA approval or commercial launch.
Additional Phase 3 study planned to support FDA approval
U.S. commercialization remains contingent on further clinical development and FDA approval.

A defined plan and results for the additional Phase 3 study, followed by an FDA decision, would be needed to make the U.S. opportunity a larger catalyst.
